GetSampleStore(IResourceStore<byte[]>, AudioMixer)

Obtains the osu.Framework.Audio.Sample.SampleStore corresponding to a given resource store. Returns the global osu.Framework.Audio.Sample.SampleStore if no resource store is passed.

public ISampleStore GetSampleStore(IResourceStore<byte[]> store = null, AudioMixer mixer = null)

Parameters

store IResourceStore<byte[]>

The osu.Framework.IO.Stores.IResourceStore`1 of which to retrieve the osu.Framework.Audio.Sample.SampleStore.

mixer AudioMixer

The osu.Framework.Audio.Mixing.AudioMixer to use for samples created by this store. Defaults to the global osu.Framework.Audio.AudioManager.SampleMixer.

Returns

ISampleStore

Remarks

By default, .wav and .ogg extensions will be automatically appended to lookups on the returned store if the lookup does not correspond directly to an existing filename. Additional extensions can be added via osu.Framework.Audio.Sample.ISampleStore.AddExtension(System.String).
